svg.title: Nagrik Seva Setu: AI-assisted civic grievance platform built for Smart India Hackathon 2025.
svg.desc: Node.js + MongoDB API syncing geotagged, voice-note complaints. LLaMA-3.1 (Groq) urgency triage; Whisper voice transcription. Analytics dashboard, geo-upvoting to merge duplicates, FCM updates. Stack: Flutter, Firebase, LLaMA-3.1, Whisper, Node.js, MongoDB. LLM urgency triage, Voice complaints via Whisper, Live FCM updates.
